paragraphs.text: The Goodnight Orthodontics difference is simple: we place patients first. Your smile goals, comfort, and individual needs are our top priorities. Dr. Mark Goodnight, Dr. Spencer Mathews, and the team take time to get to know you, so care is tailored and straightforward.

We believe orthodontic treatment should be convenient, comfortable, and built around your life. Whether you choose braces, Invisalign<sup>®</sup>, or clear braces, our recommendations are honest, education-backed, and designed to help you feel confident every step of the way.

Our office blends gentle techniques with modern technology, from digital scanning to efficient treatment planning. That combination helps us deliver reliable results while keeping visits predictable and comfortable.
Above all, we focus on relationships. Patients are greeted by name, heard when they share concerns, and given clear information so families can make informed decisions about orthodontic care.

I love my job. It’s a joy to see patients and their families at the end of treatment with confident smiles, and to build relationships along the way. I spend my days helping people I care about make positive changes in their lives, and that motivation guides how I treat every patient.

Dr. Mark Goodnight, DMD, provides full-scope orthodontic care for children, teens, and adults, including clear braces, Invisalign<sup>®</sup>, and surgical orthodontics in collaboration with specialists when needed.

Education and training include an undergraduate degree at the University of Florida, a Doctorate of Dental Medicine from the University of Florida, and orthodontic residency training at Nova Southeastern University.

A native Floridian, I enjoy family time with my wife Nancy, who is a general dentist, and our daughters Bailey and Reagan. Outside the office I like fishing, golf, and travel, and I’m active in supporting local youth sports and community events.

paragraphs.text: The first step toward achieving a beautiful, healthy smile is to schedule an appointment. To request an appointment, complete and submit the form on this page and our scheduling coordinator will contact you soon to confirm.

Every smile starts with an initial consultation. At that visit we review your medical and dental history, perform a complete oral exam with any needed X-rays, discuss treatment options, and create a customized plan that meets your goals and budget.

image.alt: Father with daughter at reception of dentist's surgery

paragraphs.text: Our team will review your insurance benefits with you and explain any coverage related to orthodontic treatment. We’ll make it simple to understand what’s covered and what to expect out of pocket.
Flexible payment plans are available and our treatment coordinator will help you find an option that fits your budget, so you can start care without delay.
Before your appointment, please complete your patient forms so we can provide safe, efficient care. Completing forms ahead of time helps your visit run smoothly.

paragraphs.text: Early, two-phase treatment can guide jaw growth and tooth eruption to prevent more invasive work later. The American Association of Orthodontists recommends an initial evaluation by age seven to identify children who may benefit.

image.alt: Young patient receiving early orthodontic intervention

paragraphs.text: Empower clear braces combine ceramic aesthetics with self-ligating efficiency, offering a discreet, comfortable option for patients who want the reliability of braces with a lower profile.
Ceramic braces are less noticeable than metal and are a popular choice for older teens and adults who want a cosmetic option while receiving the proven effectiveness of fixed braces.

image.alt: Two stylish smiling teens taking selfie with braces

paragraphs.text: Invisalign<sup>®</sup> uses a series of clear, removable aligners to move teeth with digital precision. The aligners are nearly invisible and let you brush and eat without bracket restrictions.

Most adult cases take between six and 15 months; wearing aligners 20–22 hours per day helps achieve best results. Complimentary consultations are available to see if Invisalign<sup>®</sup> is right for you.

image.alt: Close-up of clear aligners being placed on teeth

paragraphs.text: If a canine becomes impacted, a minor surgical exposure and coordinated orthodontic guidance can help the tooth erupt into its proper position. Early detection increases the likelihood of a successful outcome.
Retention keeps your new smile stable. We offer removable and fixed retainers and provide clear instructions to protect results long term, including care and wear-time guidance.

image.alt: Young woman smiling and holding orthodontic retainer

paragraphs.text: Our iTero digital scanner captures fast, radiation-free 3D images for accurate treatment planning and precise aligner or appliance fabrication without traditional impression putty.

image.alt: iTero digital scanner in use during orthodontic consultation

paragraphs.text: When skeletal jaw discrepancies require correction, we coordinate orthodontic care with oral and maxillofacial surgeons to plan safe, functional, and aesthetic orthognathic outcomes for adult patients.

image.alt: Orthodontic patient receiving orthognathic surgical consultation

paragraphs.text: Find clear, practical answers to common questions about braces, retainers, oral hygiene, appliances, treatment timelines, and how to get started with care.

accordion.header: What orthodontic treatments do you offer?

paragraphs.text: We treat patients of all ages with traditional metal and ceramic braces, clear braces, and clear aligner therapy such as Invisalign<sup>®</sup>. We also provide appliances like palatal expanders and custom retainers to support long-term results. See our Types of Appliances and Clear Braces pages for details and photos.

image.alt: Palatal expander appliance in a clinical setting

accordion.header: At what age should my child see an orthodontist?

paragraphs.text: The American Association of Orthodontists recommends an evaluation by age 7. Early assessments let us spot developing concerns and, when needed, start simple treatments that can reduce future complexity.

accordion.header: How long does treatment usually take?

paragraphs.text: Treatment length depends on the complexity of the case and the chosen appliance. Many patients finish care between 12 and 24 months, while simpler aligner cases can be shorter. We’ll give you a personalized timeline during your consultation.

image.alt: Animated demonstration of brushing technique for patients with braces

accordion.header: What payment and insurance options are available?

paragraphs.text: We offer flexible monthly payment plans and accept most major dental insurance plans. Our front office team will review your benefits, estimate out-of-pocket costs, and help set up a payment option that fits your budget.

image.alt: Animated flossing technique for patients with braces

accordion.header: How can I schedule an appointment?

paragraphs.text: Call or text us at (813) 968-3737 or (813) 805-0206 and we’ll find a time that works for your family. You can also request an appointment using our online contact form at /contact#form.
